description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in an Android application, verifying various device information and permission handling functionalities using JUnit and Robolectric.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class verifying the behavior of DeviceHandler's device info, status, permissions, and health methods.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests that handleDeviceInfo returns correct payload with stable device information.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceStatus returns a payload with correct device status details.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that handleDevicePermissions returns expected permissions and their statuses.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Ensures that partial SMS send capability grants are treated as approved.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Ensures that partial SMS read capability grants are treated as approved.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceHealth provides correct device health metrics.

methods.name: appContext
methods.description: Provides a mock application context for tests.

methods.name: parsePayload
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject for testing purposes.
